attempts.reasoning:
Build sets. EV limit 66 total, max 32 per stat.

Gholdengo: Nasty Plot, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, Recover, Leftovers, Good as Gold.
Garchomp: Swords Dance, Earthquake, Scale Shot/Dragon Claw, Stone Edge? Life Orb or Choice Scarf. Give Garchomp Rough Skin, Life Orb: SD, EQ, Dragon Claw, Stone Edge.
Rotom-Wash: Leftovers taken—give Sitrus Berry? Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Will-O-Wisp, Thunderbolt, Levitate, Sitrus Berry.
Dragonite: Multiscale, Dragon Dance, Dragon Claw/Outrage, Earthquake, Extreme Speed, Lum Berry? Or Weakness Policy not available. Lum Berry.
Garganacl: Purifying Salt, Salt Cure, Recover, Body Press, Curse? Give Leftovers? taken. Sitrus taken. Give... Big Root? No. Give Shuca Berry? Better: Leftovers to Garganacl and something else to Gholdengo? Gholdengo likes Leftovers. Garganacl: Sitrus Berry, Rotom: Wiki not available... Rotom could hold... give Rotom Leftovers, Gholdengo Air Balloon not available. Gholdengo: Leftovers; Rotom: Sitrus Berry; Garganacl: Chesto Berry with Rest? Or just Shuca. Garganacl: Salt Cure, Recover, Body Press, Curse, item Shuca Berry? Give it Leftovers and Gholdengo... Gholdengo can hold Wise Glasses? Better Leftovers on Gholdengo (wincon). Garganacl: Sitrus Berry, Rotom: Chesto? Rotom doesn't Rest. Rotom: Shuca? Rotom weak to grass—Rindo Berry. Fine.
Annihilape: Defiant, Bulk Up, Rage Fist, Drain Punch, Taunt, Leftovers? taken. Give it... Spell Tag? Or Sitrus. Give Annihilape Leftovers, Gholdengo Wise Glasses? Gholdengo needs recovery—Leftovers best. Annihilape: Spell Tag boosts Ghost? Spell Tag boosts Ghost moves—Rage Fist. OK.
